run_parallel_compose_benchmark: run the parallel compose benchmark that times gtn.compose and gtn.backward on batches of linear graphs
run_forward_score_benchmark: run the parallel forward_score benchmark that times gtn.forward_score and gtn.backward on batches of graphs
run_indexed_func_benchmark: run the parallel indexed function benchmark that times gtn.parallel_for with a custom process function
run_all_benchmarks_with_batch_size: run all three parallel benchmarks by passing a batch size B as a command line argument
review_time_compose: review the time_compose function which benchmarks parallel graph composition and backward pass performance
